hooks.name: Pre-PR gate: affected lint/test/build + .NET tests
hooks.description: Manual, opt-in gate to run before committing or opening a pull request. Mirrors the CI gate: the Nx affected lint/test/build pipeline plus the self-contained .NET test suite. Heavier than the save hooks, so it is triggered on demand rather than on every save. Blocks (exits non-zero) on the first failing step.

action.command: npx nx format:check && npx nx affected -t lint test build && dotnet test core/csharp/MicroZen.Core.sln
